OpenCode session engine - host scope
|
|-- Session.Service (public facade; session.ts)
|   |-- Session.make(): shared host-service bindings
|   |   `-- forSession(id): bound operations, not mutable conversation copies
|   |-- prompt(id, input)
|   |   |-- -> Store.get; Inbox.reconcile(messageID)
|   |   |-- -> Instance.provide: prepare; then commit staged revert; admit
|   |   `-- -> Execution.wake unless resume=false; return admission
|   |-- create / fork / revert / compact / move / permissions / agent / model
|   |   `-- -> shared services; children inherit location, default metadata/permissions
|   |-- get / list / messages / inbox / log
|   |   `-- -> Store / Inbox / Bus.log, keyed by the same sessionID
|   |-- resume / interrupt / wait -> SessionExecution
|   `-- remove: interrupt -> awaitIdle -> cancel jobs -> close transport
|       `-- delete parent, then recursively remove children
|
|-- SessionExecution (host-owned execution service)
|   |-- SessionRunCoordinator
|   |   `-- executions: Map<sessionID, Execution> (process-local)
|   |       |-- owner fiber + done Deferred + scope + pendingWake
|   |       |-- stopping + interruptionReason
|   |       `-- one busy period per session; sessions run concurrently
|   |-- Lifecycle hooks installed on coordinator
|   |   |-- started -> Bus publication + Store.claim in one transaction
|   |   |-- drain -> Instance.provide(session) -> SessionRunner.drain
|   |   |   `-- Moved / Reloaded: reacquire location and continue
|   |   `-- settled -> terminal publication + claim release / report commit
|   |       `-- shutdown interruption preserves claim instead
|   |-- SubagentReport helper (owned here; Job service is shared)
|   |   `-- durable owed report -> parent Inbox synthetic steer -> wake parent
|   `-- wake coalesces; resume runs/joins; interrupt acknowledges early
|       `-- ownership and awaitIdle extend through cleanup + settlement
|
|-- Shared host services (dependencies, not children of a session handle)
|   |-- Store / Inbox / Bus / Database: durable state and projections
|   |-- Job / SessionModelTransport: generation reports and session transport
|   |-- SessionRestart: explicitly invoked orphan-claim recovery
|   |   `-- durable retry budget -> Execution.wake; at-least-once effects
|   `-- Instance selector -> LocationServiceMap.get(session.location)
|
`-- LocationServiceMap (host-owned cache)
    `-- Location.Ref -> borrowed location service graph
        |-- shared capabilities + SessionContext / Compaction / Runner
        `-- reload detaches routing; borrowed steps retain old graph until handoff
